Read with care: resolution is decimated/coarsened to fit a RAM budget on one machine (no MPI/wavelet compression) -- see README.md "How resolution is chosen". This data format has no real per-receiver elevation source (see README "Supported input formats") -- both layers assume a flat surface, so "improved" differs from baseline only by regularization method, not topography. No published ground truth exists for this dataset to check recovered positions against -- this is a pipeline/feasibility result only, not a validated one (see README "Known limitations").
